tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Search every deal online now on Crno Jaje (crnojaje.hr, Croatia): vouchers for hotel stays and trips, wellness and spa, toplice (thermal spas), skiing, beauty treatments, health check-ups, restaurants, activities, courses, driving schools and products. All filters are optional and combine. Put Croatian words for the service in query ("wellness", "masaža", "skijanje", "jacuzzi", "romantični vikend", "zubar"); word forms are matched. Place, price, nights, persons, board and dates have their own fields; get exact category and place names from list_categories and list_places. Each result has the deal page url (where the customer buys), the price from, the regular price, the discount, the EXTRA discounts active now and the voucher's validity; get_deal gives every option and the conditions. Order: the site's own (best first), or with query the best match first.

query.description: Croatian words for the service, venue or theme ("wellness", "hotel s bazenom", "masaža lica", "Hotel Eden"). Leave places, prices, nights, persons and dates to their own fields.

category.description: A category name from list_categories ("Wellness i spa", "Toplice").

place.description: A town, island, region or country: "Opatija", "Krk", "Istra", "Dalmacija", "Zagorje", "Slovenija", "Hrvatska", or "Inozemstvo" for any country abroad.

near.description: With a town in place: deals around it too (up to 40 km).

seaside.description: Only deals on the Croatian coast (Istra, Kvarner, Dalmacija).

abroad.description: true: only deals abroad; false: only deals in Croatia.

venue.description: A hotel, restaurant, salon or partner by name ("Hotel Eden", "Terme Tuhelj").

price_min.description: EUR: an option costs at least this.

price_max.description: EUR: an option (one voucher) costs at most this.

nights_min.description: Stays: at least this many nights.

nights_max.description: Stays: at most this many nights.

adults.description: Stays: an option for at least this many adults.

children.description: Stays: an option for at least this many children with the adults.

board.description: The lowest board accepted: breakfast also takes half board and more.

date_from.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the first day the customer wants to use the voucher (stays: arrival).

date_to.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the last day (stays: departure). The voucher's validity and the option's periods must fit.

pet_friendly.description: Only deals known to accept pets.

sort.description: best (default; the site's order, or the best match with query), price_asc, price_desc, discount_desc, newest.

offset.description: Skip this many (paging: next_offset of the previous call).

extra_discount_only.description: Only deals with an EXTRA discount active now (newsletter, card or site-wide voucher).

tools.name: list_extra_discount_deals
tools.description: Deals with an EXTRA discount active right now, on top of the deal's own price: a newsletter discount, a card discount (Mastercard, Diners, ZABA) or a site-wide voucher, worded as the deal page words them (extra_discounts), with a count of each kind (extra_discount_kinds). Tell the customer about them: they make the deal cheaper today. Same filters as search_deals; biggest discount first by default.

tools.name: get_deal
tools.description: Everything about online deals by id (from search results): every option with its price, regular price, discount, nights, adults, children, board and the periods it can be used in; the description, notes and conditions (how and when the voucher is used), the address and map pin, images, extra discounts now, the voucher's validity, whether it has an online booking calendar, and the page url to buy it.

ids.description: Up to 5 deal ids at once.

tools.name: find_similar_deals
tools.description: Online deals most like a given deal: the same kind of service and categories first, then the same region, a near place and a similar price. Use for alternatives (sold out, too dear, other dates), upsell and cross-sell.

same_region.description: Only deals in the same region (or the same country abroad).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The site's menu categories that have online deals now, with their parent category and number of deals: names to use in the category filter.

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: Where the online deals are: regions of Croatia, countries abroad and towns, with the number of deals in each: names to use in the place filter.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Free nights in the online booking calendar of a hotel deal, for each option: whether a stay of its nights is free from check_in (to check_out when given) and the free nights of the next weeks. Only some hotel deals have a calendar (get_deal: online_booking_calendar); for the others the voucher is booked as its conditions say.

check_out.description: YYYY-MM-DD: departure (optional; default: the option's nights).
